description:
Why Do We Get Goosebumps? The Animal Fur Secret! — A cold gust of wind blows by, and suddenly your arms look like plucked chicken skin! What is your body doing?
Kids science answer for "why do we get goosebumps kids science cartoon" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Tiny muscles under each hair follicle tighten when you're cold or spooked, pulling hairs upright to trap warm air like a fluffy winter coat.
